summary.content:
Today's selection covers 57 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 30 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic: Claude Attacks Result of Security Gaps, Not Model Issues
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft
• **Security Alert**: Device Code Phishing Up 1,500% in 2026; Vishing Doubles
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 41 articles published in the last 24 hours
